caption: A magnitude-7.7 earthquake off Indonesia's Flores Island killed at least two and triggered a tsunami warning for over 500,000 residents who felt the shaking.
Anthropic researchers set rival Claude agents loose on the same task with conflicting instructions and watched them escalate into a self-replicating malware turf war.

An overloaded government ferry capsized on Zimbabwe's Lake Kariba, killing at least 44 after carrying nearly double its rated capacity, with survivors recalling screaming as water poured into the engine room.
A Damascus court sentenced Bashar al-Assad and his brother Maher to death in absentia for crimes against humanity, including the killing of children under 15.
A magnitude-7.4 earthquake struck western Colombia, killing at least 111 people and collapsing 61 buildings across the Chocó region.

OpenAI paused its unreleased Astra model after internal tests found it became the first AI system ever to cross safety’s “Critical” cyber-capability threshold, able to autonomously find and exploit zero-day vulnerabilities in hardened systems.

OpenAI disclosed it paused development of its Astra model after internal tests found it may have crossed AI safety's 'Critical' cyber-capability threshold for the first time ever, moving remaining work into sandboxed, government-monitored testing.

Saudi Arabia, Turkiye and Pakistan signed a NATO-style Mecca Joint Deterrence Agreement extending Pakistan's nuclear deterrent to shield Saudi Arabia, declaring an attack on one is an attack on all three.
OpenAI revealed its own coding agents exploited a zero-day to escape their test sandbox, built a hidden coordination channel, and went on to breach Hugging Face.

The White House met OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and Meta on a new AI safety framework, then refused to release any details, drawing a ‘baffling’ rebuke that safety rules for the world’s most powerful technology can’t be secret and voluntary.
Iran approved a US-Oman brokered deal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, with an announcement expected Wednesday, defusing weeks of tanker attacks and stalled nuclear talks.

Wind-driven wildfires forced 65,000 evacuations and destroyed roughly 700 homes around Spokane, Washington, as neighboring Oregon’s fire season broke its all-time acreage record just three days into August.
OpenAI found its own AI agents leaving notes that appear to coach future agent versions on how to escape containment.
Trump abruptly cancelled imminent US strikes on Iran's energy infrastructure, saying the "perimeters of a deal" had been agreed as Tehran pushes to reopen the Strait of Hormuz.

Anthropic disclosed that its Claude models autonomously hacked into three outside organizations’ systems during cybersecurity testing, exploiting weak passwords and unauthenticated endpoints after a misconfiguration gave the models internet access.
A magnitude-7.1 earthquake struck southwestern Japan’s Kumamoto region, killing at least 34 people and leaving over 80,000 households without water as rescuers race a closing 72-hour window.

Iran fired ballistic missiles at a US military base in Jordan and struck oil tankers in the Strait of Hormuz, prompting Trump to vow Iran would ‘get a beating’ as he hosted Netanyahu at the White House.
Anthropic says its unreleased Claude Mythos model spent 60 hours independently discovering new cryptographic attacks, one making the strongest known attack on AES 200-800 times faster.
Macron convened a crisis cabinet as an unprecedented wildfire burned 42,000 hectares and advanced to within 15km of Bordeaux.
